text:
sofia: quick favor — can someone run the paged-attn + op-fuse bench on A100-80GB (rig-03) with seq=8192? need throughput + peak mem and a short tail-latency check. PR is #4527: <https://git.local/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4527>

kevin: on it, queuing now on rig-03. will run both fused/unfused variants.

li: do you want gpt2-xl config or the smaller qkv toy?

sofia: gpt2-xl config please. run batch=4 and batch=8. warmup 100 steps, 200 iters. enable kv-cache warmup.

ben: heads-up — the fused kernel branch added an extra host<->device sync in the allocator path; might affect tail-latency spikes. if you see regressions, ping me. :eyes:

maya: I'll do a streaming-enabled run after kevin finishes, to validate streaming latency path. will flag if >5% regress.

bench-bot: scheduled bench run -> bench/1812349876-1 on rig-03 (A100-80GB). command:

```
./run_bench --model gpt2-xl --attn paged --kernel fused --batch 8 --seq 8192 --warmup 100 --iters 200 --capture perf_counters
```

bench-bot: baseline (unfused) queued as bench/1812349876-2 for comparison.

kevin: run finished for fused variant. quick numbers: throughput 780 tokens/s (batch=8), peak mem 45.3GB, p50 latency 12.4ms, p99 latency 68ms.

kevin: unfused run: throughput 740 tokens/s, peak mem 49.6GB, p50 13.1ms, p99 65ms. so fused wins on mem and throughput but p99 slightly higher — looks like tail spikes. attaching small log excerpt: 

```
[INFO] iter 150/200: tput=780 tok/s, gpu_mem=45.3GB, kernel_time=12.3ms
[WARN] spike detected at iter 173: latency=312ms, stack=allocator::sync_path
[INFO] perf_counters: sm_eff=0.82, l2_hit=0.76
```

sofia: thanks — can you also upload nsight traces for the iter with the spike? want to see if it's allocator sync or kernel scheduling.

kevin: uploading trace now to: <s3://redwood-bench/traces/1812349876/trace-173.nsight> and pushed perf dump to the PR.

li: I'll reproduce locally with debug alloc logs on a smaller short-run to isolate the sync. planning: batch=4, seq=4096, iter=50.

ben: if it's allocator sync we can try removing the extra sync in a follow-up patch and run a quick ablation. sounds likely based on the log.

maya: streaming run (post-kevin) shows end-to-end tail up ~8% for fused vs unfused for p99 when streaming chunk size=256. will add numbers to the issue.

sofia: ok that's actionable. @ben can you try the allocator-sync revert patch tomorrow AM and I'll coordinate a canary? if no regressions, we can include fused kernels in the next rollout.

ben: yup I'll prototype revert and bench it.

deploy-bot: canary deploy gated on no regressions. auto-check will compare 10k sample prompts after candidate build.

sofia: perfect. thanks everyone for the quick turn. leaving notes on PR with links to traces and bench ids. :rocket:

kevin: fyi bench ids: bench/1812349876-1 (fused), bench/1812349876-2 (unfused). logs + perf dumps in the PR.

li: ping me if you want a quick flamegraph capture, I can add it to the bench job.

sofia: will do. end of thread.
